The '''Hyelen''' formaly known as the '''Republic of Hyelen''' is a [[Wikipedia:Unitary parliamentary republic|unitary semi-presidential]] republic located in [[South Quia]], bordered by [[Mesjan Hyaa]] to the south-southwest, [[Nheyes Si]] ti to the north, and the [[Southern Eanif Ocean]] to the East. Covering an area of 154,449 km² (59,633 sq mi), it ranks as the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|120th]] largest country in the world. The capital and largest city is [[PrajuleD]]. The official language is Hyelenian.

Hyelen gained [[Hyelen Independence|independence]] from [[Mesjan Hyaa]] in 1758 after a [[1753 Hyelen referendum on independence|referendum on independence]] was successful in 1753, with 63% voting in favor of having an independent state. The election was the product of a compromise following a [[Hyelenian insurgency| decade-long insurgency]] against Hyian forces. Hyelen is governed through a bicameral legislature known as the [[Union of Hyelen]], consisting of the [[Hyelenian Lainar of the People|Lainar of the People]] (upper house) and the [[Hyelenian National Assembly|National Assembly]] (lower house). The head of government is the [[High Minister of Hyelen|High Minister]].

As of 1765, Hyelen has a population of approximately 1,724,000, ranking [[List of countries and dependencies by population|140th]] globally. The country's economy, measured by [[Wikipedia:Purchasing power parity|purchasing power parity]], stands at {{Lahn}}11.381 billion, placing it [[List of countries by GDP (PPP)|146th]] worldwide, with a per capita GDP (PPP) of  {{Lahn}}6,600. Hyelen has a [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Krali Total Development Index of 0.708]], classified as medium/low level of development, ranking 113th globally.
